post.description:
#### Allows creation / sending of notifications within Incident IQ.  Notifications can be directed at users with varying severity.  Content may include rich HTML and links to other resources.
#### Sample request:
```
POST /api/v1.0/alerts/new
{
  "AlertKey": "Custom-Notification-1",
  "EntityTypeId": "ac6cece8-e4f4-e511-a789-005056bb000e",
  "EntityId": "ac6cece8-e4f4-e511-a789-005056bb000e",
  "Severity": 20,
  "Subject": "Test notification 1",
  "Details": "New notification content - click <a href="#">here</a>"
}
```

parameters.description: Notification details / parameters
parameters.name: notification

parameters.description: Locate your API token under Administration > Developer tools and place after the text "Bearer " without quotes
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Recommended content-type for use with the Incident IQ API ( JSON )
parameters.name: Content-Type
